title: Oil Rubbed Bronze Toilet Paper Stand, 26-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Toilet Tissue Holder Stand, Allied Brass
description: Freestanding toilet paper stand for the bathroom, 26 inches high (26-inch, 26 in) with solid brass construction in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Use as a toilet tissue stand / toilet paper holder stand / bathroom toilet paper stand when wall space is limited—freestanding design requires no wall mounting. Contemporary, modern bathroom hardware style that fits contemporary bath accessories and minimalist bathroom fixtures. Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping, and a felt pad helps prevent scratching on floors. Includes toilet tissue stand with a color-coordinated solid brass tissue roller. Some assembly required; assembled in the U.S.A. Designer finish options provide corrosion-free, rust-free performance. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Overall dimensions: 5.5in L x 26in H x 6in W; shipping weight 6 lbs. Allied Brass TS-25.
